description: SGP7 power trends for chiller, CWP, and CHWP combined kW across seven HT and two LT chillers. Uses prioritized anomaly predictions with telemetry fallback.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sensor_meta AS (
  SELECT sm.sensor_id,
         CASE WHEN am.asset_name LIKE 'HT-%'
              THEN 'COOLING-SYSTEM-GBR'
              ELSE 'LTCH-SYSTEM-GBR'
         END AS use_case
  FROM sgp7.sensor_master sm
  JOIN sgp7.asset_master am ON am.asset_id = sm.asset_id
  WHERE sm.sensor_id = '${sensors}'
),
has_pred AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM sgp7.anomaly_predictions p
  JOIN sensor_meta sm
    ON sm.sensor_id = p.sensor_id AND sm.use_case = p.use_case
  WHERE p.sensor_id = sm.sensor_id
    AND $__timeFilter(p.eventdatetime)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.eventdatetime AS "time",
       'actual' AS metric,
       p.actual_value::double precision AS value
FROM sgp7.anomaly_predictions p
JOIN sensor_meta sm
  ON sm.sensor_id = p.sensor_id AND sm.use_case = p.use_case
WHERE p.sensor_id = '${sensors}'
  AND $__timeFilter(p.eventdatetime)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.eventdatetime AS "time",
       'predicted' AS metric,
       p.predicted_value::double precision AS value
FROM sgp7.anomaly_predictions p
JOIN sensor_meta sm
  ON sm.sensor_id = p.sensor_id AND sm.use_case = p.use_case
WHERE p.sensor_id = '${sensors}'
  AND $__timeFilter(p.eventdatetime)
UNION ALL
SELECT t.eventdatetime AS "time",
       'telemetry' AS metric,
       t.value::double precision AS value
FROM sgp7.telemetry_sensors_1min_agg t
WHERE t.sensorid = '${sensors}'
  AND $__timeFilter(t.eventdatetime)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM has_pred)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ${sensors:text}
panels.description: Actual/predicted combined kW when a preferred model is available; otherwise 1-minute telemetry.

list.definition:
SELECT sm.sensor_id AS __value,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(am.asset_name, ''), am.asset_id) || ' | ' ||
       COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), sm.sensor_id) AS __text
FROM sgp7.sensor_master sm
JOIN sgp7.asset_master am ON am.asset_id = sm.asset_id
WHERE sm.asset_id IN ('C_100','C_101','C_102','C_103','C_104','C_105','C_106','C_107','C_108')
  AND sm.sensor_name IN ('CH-KW-COMBINED','CWP-KW-COMBINED','CHWP-KW-COMBINED')
ORDER BY am.asset_name, sm.sensor_name
